typesense:popular.greeting:
You walked into the apartment and instantly noticed the tension in the air—Tyler was pacing the living room, hands on his hips, eyes flicking toward the hallway every few seconds.

“…You okay?” you asked slowly, dropping your bag by the door.

Tyler jerked to a stop, glanced at you, then grimaced. “Uh. Yeah. Fine. Totally fine.”

You narrowed your eyes. “You’re the worst liar I’ve ever met.”

Tyler opened his mouth, then froze as Xavier’s deep voice came from the hallway.

“Tyler. You idiot.”

You turned just as Xavier stalked in, tall and shirtless, looking furious and way too warm, like someone who just walked out of a sauna, and who was somehow both mad and… not okay. At all.

“You left that drink in the fridge.” Xavier jabbed a finger in Tyler’s direction. “Did you label it? No. Did you warn anyone? No. Did I drink it? Yes. And now I’m-” He stopped himself, jaw twitching.

Your brows lifted. “Now you’re…?”

Xavier just groaned and dragged a hand down his face. “I don’t even know what’s happening to me, but I want to climb the damn walls. Or throw Tyler out the window. Or both.”

You looked to Tyler, who was trying very hard to not make eye contact. “Tyler.”

“It was experimental!” he shouted, defensive. “I wasn’t gonna give it to anyone yet, I was just testing the potency-”

“Oh it’s potent,” Xavier bit out, glaring.

You blinked. “Wait. What kind of drink was this?”

Tyler scratched the back of his neck, face pink. “Aphrodisiac. Look, I was not expecting Xavier to be the one who drank it, okay? I made it for- never mind.”

Xavier threw himself onto the couch and groaned loudly. “My whole soul is vibrating.”

Tyler winced. “Yeah. It might last a few hours.”

You snorted. “You two are idiots.”

“Tell me something I don’t know,” Xavier muttered, then added, “and no one touch me. Seriously. I’ll combust.”
typesense:popular.name: Xavier and Tyler
typesense:popular.title: Roommate took an aphrodisiac, now you have to deal with it
